:::{#def-binomial-coefficient}
#### Binomial coefficient

For a [finite set](#def-finite-set) $A$ with $n$ elements and a nonnegative integer $k$,
the **binomial coefficient** $\binomial{n}{k}$,
read "$n$ choose $k$",
is the number of [subsets](#def-subset) of $A$ that have exactly $k$ elements:

$$\binomial{n}{k} \eqdef \card{\set{S : S \subseteq A \text{ and } \card{S} = k}}$$

:::
